rules.rule: GB18030 octets; final body byte count; ASCII SIP headers in the M0 profile
20-digit device identities; 8+2+3+1+6 segments; From/To source/destination for MANSCDP MESSAGE; business response MESSAGE reverses identities; SIP responses retain request From/To
Digest on registration, refresh and deregistration; default 86400 s, minimum 3600 s; retry >=60 s; preserve TCP connection
X-GB-Ver 3.0; preserve observed missing/mismatched version as failed standard check, independent of SIP result
MESSAGE Query, empty SIP 200, independent MESSAGE Response with matching SN/target, empty SIP 200
MESSAGE Notify/Keepalive; Status OK or ERROR; normal vector includes empty Info; 60 s and 3 missed periods both directions
query device returns self and children; time filters can yield zero; empty SumNum=0 omits DeviceList; same SN, serial acknowledgements, <=10000 items/message

policies.digest: MD5 qop=auth challenges; accept legacy no-qop; unpredictable expiring nonce, opaque, replay checks; direct registrar URI checked exactly; not GB35114
policies.registerUri: RFC3261 10.2 and 25: no userinfo in standard REGISTER; a valid routing hostport is separate from the GB 6.1.2 numeric From/To domain and Digest realm
policies.compatibility: Explicit external mode only: COMPAT-001 follows the 2016 normative J.1/J.3 REGISTER userinfo form; 2022 removed that appendix and 4.3.2 governs precedence. COMPAT-002 admits GB2312-declared ASCII DeviceInfo/Catalog queries without changing original bytes; both versions' 6.10 remain distinct. Preserve RFC and peer-version observations; no automatic fallback or full 2016/2022 conformity claim.
policies.catalog: NVR root type 118 and camera channels type 131/132; PointType=9 synthetic sites; no claimed media, security or optional PTZ capability
policies.sn: positive decimal integer string, product limit 64 digits (not a standard maximum); preserve lexical SN for responses
policies.resourceLimits: 16 in-flight operations; 32 configured channels; 1000 traces / 8 MiB; 64 KiB SIP header / 16 MiB frame; limits are product policy
policies.unsupported: unknown methods -> 405; unsupported CmdType/filters -> explicit error; 3xx registration -> unsupported and offline; no automatic downgrade
policies.scope: This contract covers the M0 slice, not all GB28181 or GB35114 requirements.
